'''Kirana Zar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]]. She could often be found on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], selling gear to other hunters.

==Behind the scenes==
Kirana Zar first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Columi Gear vendor for the Bounty Hunter class. During a restructuring of the game's gear system in Game Update 2.0, she was changed to a Basic Gear vendor. She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.
